description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git rebase' under various conditions and options. It sets up test repositories, executes rebase commands with different flags, and verifies the resulting commit history to ensure correct functionality.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Creates a file with specified lines and adds it to the git index.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that specified files or paths are missing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two outputs or files for equality.
